queries: WITH station_averages AS (SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS station_avg FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage), phase_summary AS (SELECT lunarstage, AVG(station_avg) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(*) AS station_count FROM station_averages GROUP BY lunarstage) SELECT lunarstage, avg_bandwidth_usage, station_count, 1.0 * station_count / SUM(station_count) OVER () AS station_fraction FROM phase_summary

WITH station_usage AS (SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS station_avg_usage FROM telescopes AS t INNER JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage), phase_summary AS (SELECT lunarstage, AVG(station_avg_usage) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(*) AS station_count FROM station_usage GROUP BY lunarstage) SELECT lunarstage, avg_bandwidth_usage, station_count, 1.0 * station_count / SUM(station_count) OVER () AS station_fraction FROM phase_summary

WITH station_averages AS (SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS station_avg FROM telescopes AS t INNER JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage) SELECT lunarstage, AVG(station_avg) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(*) AS station_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS station_fraction FROM station_averages GROUP BY lunarstage;
